events.title: HOT FIX
events.summary: We're very sorry that, after the power went out, your adventure may have been cut short by... a coffee machine. It clearly thought it was the final boss, but its reign is over! We've already released an urgent fix. Update the demo on Steam and jump back in - the story isn't over yet! We fixed this critical bug within 24 hours of a player's report. Thanks to YAROSLAVE for telling us about the problem!What else has changed🔹 Your progress is protected - we've fixed issues with saves. 🔹 Optimization
